answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46345 Country: INDIA Title: zakat,sadat,intrest Question: I have 50,000.00 zakat, 10000.00 sadaqah and 5000.00 interest. With above Rs 65000.00 (mix amount total) I want to purchase pulses, spice, sugar, tea etc and give it to poor, widow and to those eligible for zakah. Can I do so? Answer ID: 46345 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1124/861/B=1434) Yes, you may purchase these things and give them to the poor and needy ones who are eligible to receive zakah with the intention of zakah. Your zakah shall be paid. You can also give them interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
